title: security(rbac-v2): enforce KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Priya Nair
description: Context: We are rolling out RBAC v2 across control-plane surfaces and need stricter enforcement around KMS key region residency and audit logging to meet recent compliance requests from two enterprise customers. This PR enforces KMS region pinning at the resource and policy level, hardens audit logging to include KMS key resolution and region metadata, and updates RBAC v2 policy evaluation so region residency is considered during allow/deny decisions. Motivation: Previously region constraints were advisory and surfaced only in warnings. That produced gaps for customers requiring cryptographic residency guarantees. This change closes that gap by making region pinning explicit and auditable. High-level changes: 1) Policy schema extension: add `kms_region_constraint` optional field to role and resource bindings so admins can pin resources to a specific region or a list of accepted regions. 2) Policy evaluation: evaluation engine now rejects requests to encrypt/decrypt with keys outside pinned regions for resources with constraints. 3) Audit logging: include resolved KMS key ARN, resolved region, policy decision reason, and policy id in audit events for all KMS operations. 4) Migration: a one-time migration marks existing bindings without constraints as `unconstrained` and adds a compliance audit tag; customers will be notified via admin console and email. 5) API & SDK: extended Create/Update binding endpoints and SDK helpers with validation and helpful error messages. 6) Tests & CI: unit/integration tests validating policy parsing, enforcement scars, and audit payload schema. Rollout plan: feature gated behind `rbac_v2_kms_hardening` remote feature flag. Stage 1 (internal): enable for infra and security teams; Stage 2 (opt-in): enable for selected enterprise orgs; Stage 3 (enforce): global rollout after 30-day opt-in window. Backwards compatibility: bindings without region constraints remain valid unless an org explicitly opts into enforcement. There's a migration path documented in the release notes. Security review: completed with SecOps on 2026-02-12 (SEC-712). Testing: local unit tests run, integration tests against dev KMS emulator, and e2e smoke on staging. See CI checks summary below. Related: ENG-2381 implements the RBAC v2 policy extension; SUP-4432 is customer support ticket that motivated enforcement. Checklist: - [x] Add schema and validation for kms_region_constraint - [x] Wire region check into policy evaluation pipeline - [x] Add audit fields for KMS ops - [x] Add migration script and admin notification text - [x] Add API/SDK compatibility shims and input validation - [x] Add tests and update CI matrix - [x] Security review signed off Changes are described below and small snippets of changed files are included in the PR body for reviewers.
